title: Overdrive FTP suggestion dismissal
description: The body of POST /v1/ftp-suggestion/dismiss (spec §6.3, §8.3, ADR 0022): the rider keeps their FTP and hides the suggestion with this id (ftp.suggestion.id of GET /v1/metrics). A dismissed suggestion stays hidden until the service's estimate moves 3 W or more from the one that was dismissed. Accepting a suggestion is PATCH /v1/profile with the suggested ftp, which also marks the pending suggestion with that value accepted. A body that is not this is 400 invalid_json; a suggestion that does not exist is 404 not_found.
